div.div: شِوَآءٌ Roasted, broiled, or fried, flesh-meat; (S, * MA, Msb, K, * KL;) as also ↓ شُوَآءٌ ; (Ks, Sgh, K;) but the former is more usual and more chaste: (TA:) a subst. from شَوَى اللَّحْمَ: and ↓ شِوَآءَةٌ [as its n. un.] signifies a piece thereof. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
